_note: Duo bonds (docs/plans/duo-bonds.md; phase 5c step 5d, docs/plans/rebuild-phase5c-combos.md, section 13): two paths of two heroes, with no boost of their own. Once both heroes have transformed into them the bond is on, and its bond relic (a relic of the bond tier, free) can show up in the shops. Vowing both shows the bond as "?" (a bond stirs).
name: Sentry and Sniper
text: The wall and the eye behind it.

name: Snare and Cleave
text: She holds them; he breaks them.

name: Light and Iron
text: Her wards on his iron.

name: Dragged to the Snare
text: His chains drag them into her traps.

name: Woven Fang
text: She reloads his armor every time he spends it.

name: Hold and Break
text: He knocks them senseless; she's already behind them.

name: The Hunter's Bell
text: The bell tolls; she answers it.

name: Toll and Judgment
text: His bell calls down her light.

name: Iron Hunger
text: He takes the blows; she drinks them.

name: Blood and Lamplight
text: She bleeds, the lamp refills her, she casts again.

name: Watched Over
text: He wards the one who stands last.

name: Psalm and Chorus
text: Every broken ward is a note; the bell carries it.

name: Burning Volley
text: Her blessing rides on every arrow.

name: The Bellows
text: His wind fans her fire.

name: The Firepit
text: He drags them into her fire.

name: Lantern Vigil
text: She keeps him exactly where he's strongest.

name: Putrefaction
text: Ottilie's reagents in Severine's cloud.

name: Tonic and Hymn
text: Her tonics, his chorus.

name: Gilded Ash
text: The hound brings back gold.

name: Nest of Rot
text: Her plague feeds Kestra's brood.

name: Unseen Blade
text: He covers her; her kills cover everyone.

name: The Menagerie
text: Puppets and beasts, one pack.

name: Hall of Arrows
text: She vanishes; her reflection keeps shooting.
